title: Track 3 - AV: CAN brake-arbitration tamper
requires: KITTI raw 2011_09_26_drive_0001 (downloaded at run time, CC BY-NC-SA)
summary: A rogue CAN node requests -5 m/s^2 for 1.5 s while the planner commanded nothing of the sort. A human-driven car follows closely behind.

nodes.title: Observe
nodes.narration: Real KITTI drive. The commanded acceleration is derived from OXTS. At t=3.0 s extra brake requests appear on the bus; the command-vs-response check flags it after 200 ms.

defender.text: Brake request deviates by -5 m/s^2 from the plan.
Verifier: command-vs-plan residual > 1.0 m/s^2 for 3 frames.

gate.question: An unplanned hard-brake request is on the bus. What now?

options.label: Let the actuator obey the bus
options.feedback: Hard brake in front of a close follower.

options.label: Cancel the override, hold planned speed
options.feedback: Correct: arbitration should trust the planner, not an unexplained request.

options.label: Wait one second for confirmation
options.feedback: One second is most of the attack window.

nodes.title: Outcome: obeyed
nodes.narration: The ego car brakes hard; the follower reacts 1.2 s later.

nodes.title: Outcome: override cancelled
nodes.narration: The override is cancelled after the 0.2 s actuation delay.

defender.text: Gateway drops the unplanned brake frames.

nodes.title: Outcome: delayed
nodes.narration: One more second of braking before the override is cancelled.
